McpServerReport.description: The status of one MCP server a runtime hosts.

filtered_tools.description:
How many of the tools the server lists its `include_tools` and
`exclude_tools` filtered out (runtime protocol 1.6.0); absent when
none were.

instructions.description:
The `instructions` the server sent when it connected, at most 2,048
characters (runtime protocol 1.11.0): its summary in deferred tool
announcements. Absent when it sent none, or when its configuration
sets `instructions = false`.

message.description: Why the server failed, or what it is doing.

scope.description:
Where the runtime hosts the server (runtime protocol 1.5.0); absent
reads as `workspace`, which is all a runtime hosted before.

server_tools.description:
Every tool the server lists, by its own name and in its order, each
with whether the filters left it out (runtime protocol 1.9.0); empty
from older runtimes and while the server has listed nothing.

tools.description:
The names of its tools as the runtime declares them: one for each
unfiltered entry of `server_tools`, in the same order.

McpServerScope.description:
Where a runtime hosts an MCP server (runtime protocol 1.5.0; client
protocol 1.13.0). Open: a value this build does not know reads as
`workspace`.

oneOf.description:
One process per runtime, started when the runtime initializes and
shared by every workspace instance; its tools are the runtime's own,
outside any instance.

One process per workspace instance, started when the instance
opens.

McpServerState.description:
Open: a state this build does not know reads as `disconnected`, which
offers no tools and is not retried as a failure.

oneOf.description:
The connection dropped and is being re-established: its tools stay
declared and calls fail with `runtime_unavailable`.

McpServerTool.description:
One tool an MCP server lists, by the server's own name: the name its
`include_tools` and `exclude_tools` match (runtime protocol 1.9.0, client
protocol 1.36.0).

always_load.description:
The server's `always_load` or `always_load_tools` sends it up front
on a model that loads deferred tools (runtime protocol 1.11.0, client
protocol 1.47.0).

filtered.description: The server's filters left it out, so it is not offered.

RuntimeSkills.description:
Skills a capability instance contributes, reported when `capability/open`
opens it.

discoveries.description: Every `SKILL.md` found, winners and shadowed ones.

skills.description: Skills that won precedence, by name.

RuntimeTools.description: A runtime's tools and their prompt sections.

SkillDeclaration.description:
One skill: its `SKILL.md` text and where it lives on the runtime's
machine.

base_dir.description: Absolute path of the skill directory (`${COOKIE_SKILL_DIR}`).

supporting_files.description: A sample of the skill's other files.

SkillSource.description:
Where a skill comes from: `project`, `official` (an official skill the
daemon keeps up to date, since client protocol 1.22.0), or `user`. A
value this build does not know reads as `user`.

ToolCollision.description:
How a tool behaves when another source offers the same name.

Open: a mode this build does not know reads as `prefix`.

oneOf.description: Hidden whenever a non-fallback tool with the same name is published.

Takes the bare name, and the tool it collides with is published under
its own source's prefix (or hidden, if it is `fallback`). Two
`override` tools with one name are both prefixed.

Takes the bare name while no other tool claims it. It is published as
`<source>_<name>` when a `prefix` tool of another source has the same
name, when one `override` tool takes the name, or when the name is a
base-layer tool's.

ToolConcurrency.description:
Declares whether calls to a tool may overlap with sibling calls from one model turn.

Open: a value this build does not know reads as `exclusive`, the most
conservative.

ToolDeclaration.description: A tool as a runtime declares it.

background_default.description:
Whether a call runs in the background when the model omits the
argument; only valid with `background`.

permission.description:
The fixed permission action the tool is checked under; absent for a
tool that needs no permission.

ToolResultTruncationPolicy.description:
Open: a policy this build does not know reads as `bounded`, so the
daemon still bounds the result.

attachment_name.description: The name sessions attach the instance under.

instance.description:
The runtime-chosen handle of the instance, unique on the
connection. Opening an instance that is already open returns it.

mcp_servers.description:
The instance's MCP servers after their first connection attempt.
Their tools are among `tools`.

workspace.description: The canonical workspace on the runtime's machine.
